credit.title: Rutting Moose Audio Clip (Denali National Park & Preserve)
credit.author: NPS Media / Richard Nelson

species: A cow moose (Alces alces) giving her nasal, bawling call during the autumn rut in Denali National Park, Alaska
note: US National Park Service recording. The high-pass removes the measured wind rumble that dominates the recording below 200 Hz.
